newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Ireland's Cityjet to launch Dublin-Paris service.
newsitem.headline: Ireland's Cityjet to launch Dublin-Paris service.

text.p: Independent Irish airline CityJet said on Wednesday that it will commence direct scheduled services from Dublin to Charles de Gaulle airport in Paris from May 1, 1997.

The airline initially plans to operate 22 flights each week with two return flights each weekday while seats on Air France weekend flights will be available to CityJet passengers on a code share basis, the airline said in a statement.
CityJet already operates five return services each weekday on behalf of Air France from London City Airport to Charles de Gaulle airport.
The airline also said it had appointed Air France as its general sales agency within France.
Earlier this year, private Irish airline Ryanair unveiled details of its new low-price flights from Dublin to Beauvais airport, near Paris, and Charleroi, near Brussels.
